set.rappels: If you continue to the top of The Monk: three rappels of about 75 ft (23 m) down the northeast gully. No descent from the top of the route itself is documented.
set.rappel_count_note: Three rappels of roughly 75 ft (about 23 m) each down Scabo’s northeast gully. The anchor at each station is not described.
